newItems.conditions: Both adiabatic and reversible; adiabatic alone insufficient.

newItems.name: Entropy trong chu trình
newItems.conditions: State returns to same value in any cycle; reversible-heat integral restricted to reversible cycle. Entropy of entire environment included separately.
